section: 4. Create Two Virtual Expert Panels with Deep Research
content: Compile a panel of 10 people with diverse specialist competencies, personality types, and challenges that I can use as a sounding board for feedback on exam questions I write in biology and natural science. The panel's feedback should support high validity and reliability, whether the exam question is used on its own or bundled with others, so that it can be used to assess students' knowledge and understanding.  Since I want the virtual participants' traits to be grounded in relevant knowledge and skills, I am using Deep Research so Gemini first gathers and compiles relevant information before it presents the finished report that will form the basis for the expert panel.
